bodyHtml:
A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

OpenSSH 10.6p2 has been released with a workaround for a critical vulnerability. https://openssh.com/releasenotes.html#10.6p2 If you operate a Linux system that uses musl libc without PAM (Alpine Linux is one example) then stop reading and set PasswordAuthentication=no or disable SSH for these systems IMMEDIATELY. This vulnerability does not exist on non-Linux systems, Linux/glibc systems and Linux systems that use PAM for password authentication. We consider the root cause of this bug to be out
